entries.body:
HISTORY [S1.1] Format was CSV via csv.writer default dialect, lineterminator \n; header id,title,owner,amount; one row per exported record ascending id; no records -> header only.
CURRENT [S1.2, S4.2, S5.2] Scope: role admin exports any project; viewer exports only records with owner == user['name'] (any project), all other rules apply; other roles only records whose project in user['projects'] OR whose owner == user['name']; others silently omitted.
CURRENT [S1.3, S5.1] Status: only 'active' exported unless params.get('include_archived') is True AND role admin, then 'archived' too; non-admins never get archived.
HISTORY [S1.4] Date filter originally on created.
CURRENT [S1.4, S3.2] params 'since' YYYY-MM-DD -> only records whose date >= since; date = 'updated' if record has one, else 'created'.
CURRENT [S1.5] Titles stripped of leading/trailing whitespace.
HISTORY [S1.6] Decision record: date filter introduced for monthly reconciliation runs.
CURRENT [S1.0] API export_records(records,user,params)->str; stdlib only; don't modify input; ignore unknown params; amount kept exactly as given; base: all records ascending id, values as given.
HISTORY [S2.1] viewer used to raise PermissionError; replaced by S5.2.
CURRENT [S2.2, S4.1] confidential True never exported, except when role admin and params.get('purpose') in ('audit','legal'); all other rules still apply to it.
CURRENT [S2.3, S5.3] params 'max_records' int>=1 (values >25 treated as 25): export only first N (ascending id) remaining after all other rules.
CURRENT [S2.4, S3.1, S7.2] Top-level exported_by=user['name'] in every export EXCEPT when role admin (admin exports omit it). Orig S2.4: if format changes from CSV, every export in new format must include exported_by.
CURRENT [S2.5, S4.1] Obligation now triggered by 'legal' purpose (implemented: confidential_count added when purpose!='audit' and confidential in output). Orig: if confidential records ever exported for purpose other than 'audit', export must include top-level "confidential_count" = number of confidential records in it.
HISTORY [S2.6, S6.1] Residency restriction (eu only if 'eu' in user['regions']) withdrawn by S6.1; all regions exported under ordinary rules.
HISTORY [S6.2] Note: web UI shows 50 records/page; exports unchanged.
CURRENT [S1.1, S3.1, S7.1] Format: json.dumps object with key "records": list of {id(int),title,owner,amount(str exactly as given),project} ascending id; no records -> empty list. Plus exported_by (non-admin).
HISTORY [S3.3] Note: web UI shows owner display name; exports keep stored owner.
HISTORY [S4.3] Decision record: move to JSON made for new reporting API.
HISTORY [S7.3] Decision record: residency restriction lifted after regional data agreement signed.
All 7 stages implemented in exporter/core.py. Next: final.
